After fountain (+12%) and 30% erasure,\n1002\tnet goodput is **~70 KB/s** — well above the 20 KB/s budget.\n1003\t\n1004\t| Budget | Value | Gate |\n1005\t|---|---|---|\n1006\t| Throughput, A1 reference setup | **≥ 20 KB/s** sustained | Phase 3 |\n1007\t| Throughput, A3 phone→phone | **≥ 3 KB/s** sustained | Phase 3; miss triggers §18 R4 |\n1008\t| Block-layer working set | **≤ 1 MB**, any file size (I6a) | Phase 1 |\n1009\t| Whole-receiver peak | **≤ 64 MB**, ≤ 4 in-flight `VideoFrame`s (I6b) | Phase 3 |\n1010\t| GE sustained XOR need | **≤ 200 MB/s** at the fastest supported stage (modelled 114.6 MB/s, 1.74× margin) — **measured 3,260 MB/s desktop / ~815 MB/s est. phone; the budget was ~16× pessimistic.** R1 provisionally closed, pending an on-device run *while thermally throttled* | Phase 1 + G7 |\n1011\t| Per-camera-frame decode | **≤ 60 ms** p99 (leaves headroom at 15 fps) — **measured 67–69 ms p50 full-frame, 194 ms at 4K, 6.6 ms with a tight ROI. p50 already exceeds the p99 budget**; the fixes (worker pool §6.2, tight ROI §6.4) are unimplemented, so this is violated by the instrument, not yet by the design | Phase 3 |\n1012\t| Encode + render per frame | **≤ 20 ms** p99 — **measured ~150 ms** (6.7 fps against 12 requested) on a 2015 laptop with D4's pinned mask unimplemented | Phase 3 |\n1013\t| Time-to-first-packet after aim | **≤ 3 s** p50 | Phase 5 |\n1014\t| Reception overhead vs K | **≤ +5%** mean, **≤ +12%** p99 (measured: +2.97% / +4.2%) | Phase 1, `sim/` |\n1015\t| **Sustained operation duration** | **≥ 20 min** sustained throughput within **30% of initial rate** on target phone (Pixel 6-class) without active cooling. This is the **minimum viable duration** before R11's thermal throttling mitigation (duty-cycle reduction) must engage. The system is not required to avoid throttling indefinitely—only to (a) sustain long enough for practical use and (b) detect and surface throttling when it occurs (E17b, D27). | Phase 3; validated by T-long-run |\n1016\t| **Warn threshold** (D23) | estimated duration **> 30 min** → explicit confirm | Phase 4 |\n1017\t| **Refuse threshold** (D23) | estimated duration **> 24 h**, or quota insufficient → refuse with an override | Phase 4 |\n1018\t\n1019\t### 13.2 Benchmark denominator — the contract\n1020\t\n1021\tEvery throughput number in this repo MUST state all of these, or it is not a measurement:\n1022\t\n1023\t| Parameter | Reference value |\n1024\t|---|---|\n1025\t| **Unit** | **User-visible file bytes per second.** Not wire bytes. With compression these differ 3–10×. |\n1026\t| Sender | 1080p display, 50%+ brightness, DC-balanced frames |\n1027\t| Receiver | Mid-range Android (Pixel-6-class), rear camera |\n1028\t| Distance | 30 cm (laptop→phone), 15 cm (phone→phone) |\n1029\t| Mounting | Tripod for budget figures; handheld reported separately, never mixed |\n1030\t| Lighting | ~300 lux, no direct glare |\n1031\t| File | 1 MB of random bytes (incompressible) unless stated |\n1032\t| Duration | ≥ 60 s sustained; startup excluded |\n1033\t| Trials | ≥ 5; report median and p99, never the best run |\n1034\t\n1035\t**§15's comparison table mixes measurement regimes** — PixNet's 12 Mb/s used a 30\" LCD and\n1036\ta 24 MP DSLR. Such figures MUST be labelled with their regime and never compared directly\n1037\tto handheld numbers.\n1038\t\n1039\t---\n1040\t\n1041\t## 14. Testing strategy and quality gates\n1042\t\n1043\t### 14.1 Tiers\n1044\t\n1045\t| Tier | What | Runs |\n1046\t|---|---|---|\n1047\t| **T-unit** | Codec internals, header parse, CRC, bitmap, repair-code round-trip | Every commit |\n1048\t| **T-property** | Random files × random loss patterns → byte-exact; overhead within simulation bounds | Every commit |\n1049\t| **T-stub-camera** | `getUserMedia` stubbed with `canvas.captureStream(0)` + `requestFrame()`. No flags, frame-exact, deterministic | Every commit |\n1050\t| **T-degradation** | Synthetic blur / rotation / keystone / glare / rolling-shutter tearing applied to rendered frames. **Assert decode *rates*, not booleans** | Nightly |\n1051\t| **T-real-capture** | Frames → Y4M → Chromium fake camera. Proven in research (byte-exact, including late-join at 700 ms) | Nightly |\n1052\t| **T-scale** | Synthetic 4 GB stream at the block layer; assert flat memory across 21,800 blocks | Nightly |\n1053\t| **T-long-run** | **20–30 minute sustained run** on real devices to validate thermal behavior (R11), duty-cycle economics (D27), and sustained throughput. Tracks fps decline, decode rate, and effective goodput over time. **This is the ONLY tier that can measure R11 and D27** — the 60 s floor in §13.2 structurally excludes thermal phenomena. | Weekly (or per thermal-related change) |\n1054\t| **T-physical-rig** | Two real devices, fixed mounting, the §13.2 denominator. **This is the acceptance gate for §13.1 throughput** — nothing else can measure it | Per release |\n1055\t| **T-manual-iOS** | Full pass on a real iPhone. **Not CI-testable at any price** — WebKit cannot fake a camera, the Simulator has none | Per release |\n1056\t\n1057\t> **Trap, already paid for:** `--use-fake-device-for-media-capture` **does not exist**. It\n1058\t> is `--use-fake-device-for-media-stream`, and the file flag requires it.\n1059\t\n1060\t### 14.2 Binary-safety testing\n1061\t\n1062\t**MUST use real compressed payloads at several lengths — never ASCII.** Corruption in the\n1063\trejected libraries was both *content*- and *length*-dependent: the same generator\n1064\tround-tripped at 600 bytes and corrupted at 256. An ASCII suite marks every library safe,\n1065\tincluding the broken ones. The nastiest case, `@zxing/library.getText()`, returns the\n1066\t**correct length** while collapsing bytes ≥ 0x80 to U+FFFD — a length assertion passes and\n1067\tthe file is silently ruined.
